from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_algorithms import VQE
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA
from qiskit.circuit.library import TwoLocal
from qiskit_nature.second_q.drivers import PySCFDriver
from qiskit_nature.second_q.mappers import JordanWignerMapper
from qiskit_nature.second_q.problems import ElectronicStructureProblem
from qiskit_nature.second_q.transformers import ActiveSpaceTransformer
from qiskit_nature.second_q.formats.gauss_integrals import load_gauss_integrals
import numpy as np

def vqe_hf_sto3g_cas22():
    # Define the geometry of HF
    geometry = [("H", (0.0, 0.0, 0.917)), ("F", (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))]
    
    # Set up the PySCF driver
    driver = PySCFDriver(
        atom="H 0 0 0.917; F 0 0 0",
        basis="sto3g",
        charge=0,
        spin=0,
    )
    
    # Get the electronic structure problem
    es_problem = ElectronicStructureProblem(driver)
    
    # Define the active space
    active_space_transformer = ActiveSpaceTransformer(num_electrons=10, num_molecular_orbitals=6)
    es_problem = active_space_transformer.transform(es_problem)
    
    # Obtain the Hamiltonian in the active space
    second_q_ops = es_problem.second_q_ops()
    mapper = JordanWignerMapper()
    hamiltonian = mapper.map(second_q_ops[0])
    
    # Set up the VQE algorithm
    ansatz = TwoLocal(rotation_blocks="ry", entanglement_blocks="cz")
    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=500)
    backend = AerSimulator()
    vqe = VQE(ansatz=ansatz, optimizer=optimizer, quantum_instance=backend)
    
    # Run the VQE algorithm
    result = vqe.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(hamiltonian)
    
    # Calculate the ground state energy estimate
    ground_state_energy_estimate = result.eigenvalue.real
    
    # Reference energy for HF (STO-3G) is known to be approximately -106.77933562988664 Ha
    reference_energy = -106.77933562988664
    energy_error_against_reference = abs(ground_state_energy_estimate - reference_energy)
    
    # Check if chemical accuracy is achieved (error < 1e-4 Ha)
    chemical_accuracy_achievement = energy_error_against_reference < 1e-4
    
    # Measurement cost, qubit count, circuit depth, and gate count
    measurement_cost = result.cost_function_evals
    qubit_count = hamiltonian.num_qubits
    circuit_depth = ansatz.decompose().depth()
    gate_count = ansatz.decompose().count_ops()
    
    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": ground_state_energy_estimate,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy_error_against_reference,

        "gate_count": gate_count
    }
